exercises.title: Balanced brackets — and where the first error is
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static String check(String s) for the brackets (), [], {} (other characters are ignored). Return:

  • "OK" when every bracket is matched;
  • "MISMATCH at i" — a closing bracket at index i does not match the last open one;
  • "UNEXPECTED at i" — a closing bracket at index i with nothing open;
  • "UNCLOSED at i" — the end is reached with brackets still open; i = index of the innermost unclosed one (the top of the stack).

Report the first error from the left. Push the index of every opening bracket, not the character, so you can report positions.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • One pass with a stack: O(n).
  • Exact result strings.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hoàn thiện static String check(String s) cho các ngoặc (), [], {} (ký tự khác bỏ qua). Trả về "OK" khi mọi ngoặc khớp; "MISMATCH at i" — ngoặc đóng ở chỉ số i không khớp ngoặc mở gần nhất; "UNEXPECTED at i" — ngoặc đóng ở chỉ số i mà không có gì đang mở; "UNCLOSED at i" — hết chuỗi mà vẫn còn ngoặc mở, i = chỉ số ngoặc mở trong cùng (đỉnh ngăn xếp).

Báo lỗi đầu tiên tính từ trái. Đẩy chỉ số của mỗi ngoặc mở chứ không phải ký tự, để báo được vị trí.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The most recently opened bracket must be closed first — exactly LIFO, so a stack fits. Each character is pushed and popped at most once: O(n). The same idea checks HTML tags and matches begin/end blocks in compilers.

exercises.title: Evaluate a postfix (RPN) expression
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static String eval(String expr): tokens are separated by spaces; numbers are integers (maybe negative, e.g. -3), operators are + - * / (integer division, as in Java). Return the result as text, or:

  • "ERROR: not enough operands" — an operator finds fewer than two values on the stack;
  • "ERROR: too many operands" — more than one value is left at the end (or none: an empty expression);
  • "ERROR: division by zero".

"5 1 2 + 4 * + 3 -" → "14". Mind the order: for a b - the stack gives b first.

Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • One pass, a stack of long values.
  • Exact error strings.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Postfix needs no parentheses and no precedence: each operator applies to the two most recent values, which are the top two of the stack. One pass, O(n). This is how the JVM itself executes expressions — on an operand stack.

exercises.title: Infix to postfix with the shunting-yard algorithm
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static String toPostfix(String infix): operands are single letters or digits, operators + - * / (left-associative, * / before + -), parentheses allowed, spaces ignored. Return the postfix tokens separated by one space: "a+b*(c-d)/e" → "a b c d - * e / +".

Rules: an operand goes straight to the output; an operator first pops to the output every operator on the stack with greater or equal precedence (stopping at (), then is pushed; ( is pushed; ) pops until the matching ( (which is discarded). At the end pop everything. You may assume the input is well formed.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • One pass with an operator stack: O(n).
  • Tokens separated by exactly one space.

exercises.title: Undo and redo with two stacks
exercises.problemHtml:
A tiny text editor. Editor keeps the text in a StringBuilder; actions are type(String s) (append) and delete(int k) (remove the last k characters, fewer if the text is shorter). undo() reverts the last action, redo() re-applies the last undone one; both return false when there is nothing to do. Any new action clears the redo history.

Store on the undo stack what is needed to revert: for type the length typed, for delete the characters actually removed.

Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • undo and redo are O(length of the action).
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Một trình soạn thảo tí hon. Editor giữ văn bản trong StringBuilder; thao tác gồm type(s) (nối thêm) và delete(k) (xoá k ký tự cuối, ít hơn nếu văn bản ngắn hơn). undo() hoàn tác thao tác gần nhất, redo() làm lại thao tác vừa hoàn tác; cả hai trả false khi không có gì để làm. Thao tác mới nào cũng xoá sạch lịch sử redo.

Lưu trên ngăn xếp undo những gì cần để hoàn tác: với type là chuỗi đã gõ, với delete là các ký tự đã thực sự bị xoá.

Máy chấm biên dịch src/ bằng javac, chạy 2 ca (1 ca ẩn — không in trong đề), so output từng dòng (bỏ qua khoảng trắng cuối dòng và kiểu xuống dòng Windows/macOS), in diff dòng sai rồi cho điểm. In ALL CHECKS PASSED ⇒ quay lại đây bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải. node cham.mjs --case 2 --show in input và toàn bộ output của bạn cho ca 2.

Yêu cầu

  • Hai ngăn xếp (Deque) các thao tác.
  • undo và redo là O(độ dài thao tác).

hintsJson: Represent each action as (kind, string). Applying "typed s" appends s; reverting it cuts s.length() characters. "Deleted s" is the mirror image.|||Biểu diễn mỗi thao tác là (loại, chuỗi). Áp dụng "đã gõ s" là nối s; hoàn tác là cắt s.length() ký tự. "Đã xoá s" là ảnh gương.

undo: pop from undo, revert, push on redo. redo: pop from redo, apply, push on undo. type/delete: apply, push on undo, clear redo.|||undo: pop khỏi undo, hoàn tác, đẩy vào redo. redo: pop khỏi redo, áp dụng, đẩy vào undo. type/delete: áp dụng, đẩy vào undo, xoá redo.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The last action done is the first to undo (LIFO), and the last undone is the first to redo (LIFO again): two stacks. Storing the removed text makes every action reversible. Editors and IDEs implement exactly this "command" pattern.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Thao tác làm sau cùng được hoàn tác đầu tiên (LIFO), thao tác hoàn tác sau cùng được làm lại đầu tiên (lại LIFO): hai ngăn xếp. Lưu phần chữ đã xoá làm mọi thao tác đều đảo ngược được. Trình soạn thảo và IDE cài đúng mẫu "command" này.

mistakesJson.loi: Recording delete(k) as "k characters" — after undo you no longer know WHICH characters to put back.|||Ghi delete(k) là "k ký tự" — sau khi undo không còn biết phải trả lại NHỮNG ký tự nào.

Not clearing redo on a new action — redo then re-applies an action from a history that no longer exists.|||Không xoá redo khi có thao tác mới — redo sau đó áp lại một thao tác của lịch sử không còn tồn tại.
